question: What is the perimeter of an equilateral triangle with side 13 cm?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

An equilateral triangle has 3 equal sides.

Perimeter = 3 × Side

Perimeter = 3 × 13 = 39 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 39 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Side of the equilateral triangle (a) = 13 cm

**Formula Used:**

Perimeter of an equilateral triangle = a + a + a = 3a

**Calculation:**

⇒ Perimeter = 3 × 13

⇒ Perimeter = 39 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 39 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of Equilateral Triangle

The area is calculated using the formula: Area = (√3 ÷ 4) × a², where a is the side length.

Height of Equilateral Triangle

The altitude or height is given by: h = (√3 ÷ 2) × a.

Key Properties

All three sides are equal in length, and all three internal angles measure exactly 60°. The centroid, circumcenter, incenter, and orthocenter all coincide at the same central point.
